_note: Drives the three Resource Hub sub-pages. Shanelle's structure decisions, 2026-09-01. To add a resource, add an entry to the right list and run `python build.py` - no template or CSS change needed. An entry with an empty `url` renders as a name and description with a 'link coming' marker rather than a dead link, which is the agreed treatment while content arrives over time. Never invent a URL: leave it empty until Legacy supplies it.

trusted_organizations.title: Organizations we refer to
trusted_organizations.blurb: The organizations Legacy regularly points caregivers toward. We know these teams and we trust them with the families we serve.

items.name: Alzheimer's Association – Wisconsin Chapter
items.note: Provides dementia education, caregiver support, local programs, resources, and a 24/7 Helpline for individuals and families impacted by Alzheimer's and other dementias.

items.name: Wisconsin Alzheimer's Institute – Milwaukee
items.note: Provides culturally responsive dementia education, caregiver support, community programs, research opportunities, and resources for Milwaukee and Southeastern Wisconsin communities.

items.name: Lorenzo's House
items.note: Provides connection, education, advocacy, and support for families navigating younger-onset dementia, including spouses, children, and other family caregivers.

items.name: Milwaukee County Aging & Disability Resource Center (ADRC)
items.note: Helps older adults, people with disabilities, and families navigate community resources, benefits, dementia care, long-term care options, and other available services.

items.name: CarePatrol of the Milwaukee Area
items.note: Helps families navigate local senior care options, including assisted living, memory care, independent living, and other supportive care settings.

items.name: Oasis Senior Advisors – Milwaukee
items.note: Provides personalized local guidance to help families explore senior living and care options based on their loved one's needs, preferences, and circumstances.

items.name: Life Navigators
items.note: Provides information, advocacy, support, and future planning resources for individuals with disabilities and their families.

items.name: Respite Care Association of Wisconsin (RCAW)
items.note: Connects Wisconsin families with respite care information, resources, providers, training, and programs that can help make respite more accessible.

items.name: Hilarity for Charity (HFC)
items.note: Supports families impacted by Alzheimer's and dementia through caregiver resources and programs, including respite care assistance for eligible families.

items.name: St. Ann Center for Intergenerational Care
items.note: Provides adult day services and supportive care, including specialized dementia care and overnight respite options that give family caregivers an opportunity to take a break.

items.name: SeniorLAW – Legal Action of Wisconsin
items.note: Provides free civil legal assistance to Milwaukee County residents age 60 and older, including help with public benefits, housing, health care, consumer issues, and other legal concerns affecting older adults.

caregiver_recommended.title: Our caregivers' trusted resources
caregiver_recommended.blurb: Recommended by the caregivers in our community, not by us. If something helped you, tell us and we will add it here.

follow_and_learn.title: Voices worth following
follow_and_learn.blurb: Dementia and caregiving accounts, online educators and people whose work we think is worth your time.

items.name: Adria Thompson | Be Light Care
items.note: Speech-language pathologist and dementia educator sharing practical, easy-to-understand strategies for communication, behaviors, personal care, and everyday dementia caregiving.

items.name: Dr. Macie P. Smith | Just Ask Dr. Macie
items.note: Gerontologist and licensed social worker sharing approachable dementia education to help families better understand behaviors, communication, caregiving, and aging.

items.name: Jessica C. Guthrie | When Career & Caregiving Collide
items.note: Family caregiver, advocate, educator, and speaker sharing an honest look at caring for her mother living with Alzheimer's disease and navigating caregiving as a young Black caregiver.

items.name: Carrie Aalberts | Dementia Darling
items.note: Gerontologist and dementia educator sharing caregiver education, resources, encouragement, and a more joyful, human-centered perspective on dementia and aging.

items.name: Dr. Natali Edmonds | Dementia Careblazers
items.note: Board-certified geropsychologist providing practical dementia education to help family caregivers navigate behaviors, safety, caregiver stress, and everyday caregiving challenges.

items.name: Teepa Snow | Positive Approach to Care
items.note: Dementia care educator and occupational therapist known for practical, hands-on approaches to understanding brain changes, communication, behaviors, and supporting people living with dementia.

items.name: Jacquelyn Revere | Mom of My Mom
items.note: Former millennial family caregiver who shares her experience caring for her mother with dementia, including the realities of caregiving, grief, identity, advocacy, and life after caregiving.

items.name: Ashley Stevens | The Dementia Guru
items.note: Gerontologist and licensed clinical social worker sharing dementia education with a focus on caregiving challenges, family dynamics, care decisions, and supporting families throughout the dementia journey.

items.name: Rev. Katie Norris | Creative Connections Dementia
items.note: Dementia educator sharing relationship-centered and trauma-informed approaches to dementia care, with an emphasis on connection, communication, and helping families create meaningful experiences.

items.name: Dementia Success Path
items.note: Practical dementia caregiving education focused on challenging behaviors, activities, caregiver self-care, and strategies families can use in everyday life.

caregiver_tools.title: Guides, worksheets and checklists
caregiver_tools.blurb: Practical materials made by Legacy — things to print, fill in and bring with you.
